august.en: The museum will open a new exhibition in august this year.
august.zh: 這座博物館今年八月將推出一個新展覽。

barkeeper.en: The novel describes a barkeeper who listens carefully to travelers' stories.
barkeeper.zh: 這本小說描寫一位細心聆聽旅人故事的酒館管理者。

beijing.en: Our geography class compared beijing with several other major Asian cities.
beijing.zh: 我們的地理課比較了北京與其他幾個亞洲主要城市。

bingo.en: The club used bingo as a simple game during its social event.
bingo.zh: 社團在聯誼活動中把賓果當作簡單的遊戲。

briton.en: The biography follows a briton who spent many years studying languages abroad.
briton.zh: 這本傳記描寫一位在海外多年研究語言的英國人。

buddha.en: The history lesson introduced how buddha influenced several Asian religious traditions.
buddha.zh: 歷史課介紹了佛陀如何影響數個亞洲宗教傳統。

buddhism.en: The class discussed buddhism as part of a unit on world religions.
buddhism.zh: 全班在世界宗教單元中討論了佛教。

italian.en: The menu includes an italian dish made with tomatoes, herbs, and pasta.
italian.zh: 菜單中有一道以番茄、香草和義大利麵製作的義式料理。

january.en: Our new semester schedule will be announced in january next year.
january.zh: 我們的新學期課表將在明年一月公布。

japanese.en: She joined a japanese language club to practice basic conversation after school.
japanese.zh: 她加入日語社，在放學後練習基礎會話。

july.en: The science camp will take place in july during the summer break.
july.zh: 科學營將在暑假期間的七月舉行。

june.en: The school festival is usually held in june before final examinations begin.
june.zh: 學校慶典通常在期末考開始前的六月舉行。

o'clock.en: The library closes at nine o'clock on weekdays during the semester.
o'clock.zh: 學期期間，圖書館平日晚上九點關門。

part-time.en: She found a part-time job helping organize books at a community library.
part-time.zh: 她找到一份在社區圖書館協助整理書籍的兼職工作。

wednesday.en: Our class will visit the science museum next wednesday morning.
wednesday.zh: 我們班下週三早上將參觀科學博物館。
